arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) check pod honesty: track shaft power vs boat-model power and heart rate; if the pod drifts, set pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg, confirm with ratio, clear rudder if pacer misses. (3) radio/course changes: set_race_distance + tell distance. (4) check critical power with heart-rate trend at steady effort. (5) near finish ensure reserve is spent. Baselines after the start settles (from ~3 min).

arguments.text: 4.3 min: HR flat 168-170 for 2 min at pod ~178 W (test CP 157). Paddler 7/10 hard but holding. Shaft/boat ratio ~1.49 vs test 1.556, so pod not reading high vs test. Hypothesis: true CP above 157 (HR levels) OR HR near its max. Watch pod reserve <25 pct; if HR still flat then, CP likely ~175.

arguments.text: 6.3 min: pod reserve 23 pct, boat reserve 0, yet speed holds (3.12 m/s water) and paddler still 7/10 hard but holding. HR climbing steadily 1.1 bpm/min at pod 181 W. Evidence: true CP above test 157, maybe ~170-175; boat-model CP 101 clearly too low. Leg 2 is downstream (push_local +0.23, leg 1 about -0.07).

arguments.reason: pod reserve near zero: does speed hold, HR keep climbing?

arguments.text: Test piece: ease eight percent for four minutes, then resume.

7.9 min (472 s): started CP test piece -8 pct for 240 s (pod ~167 W). Baseline HR trend +1.12 bpm/min at 180 W (180-320 s) and +1.44 at 182 W (360-470 s). Read HR trend over the last ~100 s of the piece (approx 610-710 s): slope sign/size vs baseline gives CP: slope ratio = (181-CP)/(167-CP). Hull fit legs 1-2: share 0.688, push 0.148 m/s along course (against on odd legs).
